description:
Goal
Define the transport shape agreement lattice as a first-class monotone type, so the cross-executable input-merge is correct-by-construction (data-model up).

What
- Add a sticky three-state binding: Unbound (bottom, no contribution yet) -> Agreed(ShapeId) (all contributors carry one shape) -> Conflicted (top, >=2 distinct shapes seen). Strictly monotone, height <= 2, no widening budget needed.
- Implement JoinContribution for it (bottom/join_assign/equivalent) mirroring impl JoinContribution for RuntimeDemand (semantic.rs:1015-1025). join_assign: Unbound is identity; Agreed(a)+Agreed(a)=Agreed(a); anything else with two distinct shapes = Conflicted (sticky).
- Unit tests: monotone ascent only, order-independent join, stickiness of Conflicted, Unbound distinct from Conflicted (the unknown-is-not-none distinction).

Why
Shapes are interned/flat with NO existing join operator (confirmed). This is the ONE small operator the decomposition must introduce; everything else reuses existing machinery. Pure addition, no behavior change.

Verify
New unit tests green; existing suite unaffected; zero warnings.

ShapeAgreement in transport.rs (vocabulary, no upward dep); JoinContribution impl in semantic.rs beside RuntimeDemand. 4 unit tests green (ascent, order-independence, sticky top, unbound!=conflicted, contribution delegation). shadow==monolith green; clippy -D warnings clean. Pure addition.

title: Stage 2 groundwork: define the sticky three-state shape-agreement lattice + JoinContribution
